perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.brutality.crus: Much stronger but less frequent critical hits.
perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.brutality.stea: Much more frequent but weaker critical hits.
perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.fury.tempered_: Slightly less damage from lost health, but you heal more the more wounded you are.
perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.fury.unleashed: Even more damage the less health you have, uncapped, but you heal much less from all sources.
perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.hardened.carni: Meat fills you twice as much, but you cannot eat anything that is not meat.
perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.hardened.endur: When you drop below a certain health you take less damage for a few seconds. You heal slightly less.
perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.iron_skin.ligh: Less armor and toughness while unarmored, but you are faster.
perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.iron_skin.rein: More armor and toughness while unarmored, but you are slower.
perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.stampede.crush: Charge stuns twice as long and ends with a damaging shockwave, but takes longer to recharge.
perk.rpgclasses.barbarian.stampede.unsto: Charge pierces through enemies and hits all of them for less damage, without stunning.
perk.rpgclasses.mage.cadence.arcane_cade: Even shorter cooldowns, in exchange for some spell power.
perk.rpgclasses.mage.cadence.blood_magic: If you lack mana, you pay for the spell with health, without dropping below a minimum.
perk.rpgclasses.mage.fluidity.arcane_ste: After casting a spell you run faster for a moment.
perk.rpgclasses.mage.fluidity.feather_fa: No fall damage, and you fall slowly while holding jump. You move slightly slower.
perk.rpgclasses.mage.power.point_blank_p: More damage against close targets and less against distant ones.
More damage against distant targets and less against close ones.
Less maximum mana, but you recover it 60% faster (mana per second).
perk.rpgclasses.mage.reserve.mana_well.d: Much more maximum mana, but you recover it 40% slower (mana per second).
perk.rpgclasses.mage.summoning.elite.des: Each summoning spell creates one fewer summon (minimum one), but they are stronger and slightly more expensive.
perk.rpgclasses.mage.summoning.legion.de: Each summoning spell creates one more summon, but all of them are weaker.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.fist.early_ignition: You can launch Fiery Strike from 6 charges, but it deals +4% damage per charge instead of +5%.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.fist.steady_flame.d: Fire charges fade half as fast, but each one gives 20% less damage.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.meditation.clear_mi: While meditating you purge a negative effect every 5 s.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.meditation.deep_tra: You heal twice as fast while meditating and up to 80% of your health, but take longer to start.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.skin.spirit_skin.de: Less armor and toughness, but you take much less magic and elemental damage.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.skin.stone_echo.des: The absorption of the Stone discharge is doubled, but you only gain Stone charges from hits dealing 4 or more damage.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.stance_mastery.cont: When switching stance you keep 30% of the charges in the new one and only discharge the rest. You switch stance 1 s slower.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.stance_mastery.domi: Crouch + the stances key sets your favorite stance: its discharge and stance effect are 30% stronger, and those of the other two are 30% weaker.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.wind.light_feet.des: You ignore cobwebs, soul sand, honey, powder snow and the slowdown from eating or using items. Slightly less speed.
perk.rpgclasses.monk.wind.running_moment: After running for a moment, your next unarmed hit deals more damage and knocks back more.
perk.rpgclasses.paladin.banner.life_bann: Your aura regenerates your allies' health (not yours).
perk.rpgclasses.paladin.banner.war_banne: Your aura also increases your allies' damage, but you lose armor.
perk.rpgclasses.paladin.cuirass.colossal: More maximum health, but you are slightly slower.
perk.rpgclasses.paladin.cuirass.heavy_cu: Your armor pieces protect even more, but you are slightly slower.
perk.rpgclasses.paladin.push.shield_coun: When you block a melee hit with a shield, you throw the attacker back.
perk.rpgclasses.paladin.push.shockwave.d: Every few hits you release a wave that pushes and damages nearby enemies.
perk.rpgclasses.paladin.smite.condemn.de: You mark your target: it takes more damage from you. You cannot mark another while it lasts.
Every few hits you unleash area holy damage, in exchange for less base damage.
perk.rpgclasses.paladin.will.will_vs_con: Immune to slowness, weakness, blindness, fatigue, nausea and darkness. Other negative effects last longer on you.
perk.rpgclasses.paladin.will.will_vs_dam: Immune to effects that deal damage (poison, wither, burning). Other negative effects last longer on you.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.aim.mobile_shoote: More damage while moving; less if you stand still.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.aim.steady_shoote: More damage if you have stood still for a moment; less if you shoot while running or airborne.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.cadence.agile_sho: Drawing the bow does not slow you down, but you draw slightly slower.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.cadence.quick_cou: After taking a melee hit, your next arrow fires with an instant draw and slightly less damage.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.range.hunters_mar: The impact marks the target: it takes more damage from all sources.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.range.piercing.de: The arrow pierces one more enemy, with slightly less damage to the first.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.retreat.evasive_l: Every so often, the first melee hit makes you leap backward without taking damage.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.retreat.hunter_tr: After taking a melee hit you leave a trap that heavily slows whoever steps on it.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.special_arrows.ex: Normal arrows explode on impact without breaking blocks and knock back nearby enemies, with less direct damage.
perk.rpgclasses.ranger.special_arrows.st: The impact slows the target, but your arrows fly slightly slower.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.acrobatics.counter: After a successful dodge, your next hit deals more damage.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.acrobatics.long_ro: The dodge covers more distance, but its invulnerability lasts less.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.edge.flurry.desc: You attack even faster, with slightly less damage.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.edge.flurry.name: Flurry
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.edge.thrust.desc: You ignore part of the target's armor, but attack slower.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.edge.thrust.name: Thrust
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.shadow.deep_stealt: Stealth lasts considerably longer, but mobs detect you from farther away.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.shadow.treacherous: More damage against enemies that are not targeting you. Stealth lasts less.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.toxins.concentrate: Toxin deals the same damage, but much faster.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.toxins.prolonged_d: Toxin deals the same damage, more slowly, and slows the target while it lasts.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.wind.evasion.desc: Chance to dodge hits and projectiles by leaping backward. Less maximum health.
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.wind.evasion.name: Evasion
perk.rpgclasses.rogue.wind.lightness.des: More movement and attack speed, but Stealth runs out sooner.
race.rpgclasses.dwarf.desc: Short and slow, but a born miner: breaks stone and ores faster and has racial Fortune on ores (it doesn't add to the enchantment: the higher one counts).
race.rpgclasses.dwarf.name: Dwarf
race.rpgclasses.elf.desc: Passes through leaves and climbs them like scaffolding (jumping goes up, crouching goes down). Cannot eat meat or fish.
race.rpgclasses.elf.name: Elf
race.rpgclasses.goblin.desc: Half the height: very hard to hit and fits through small gaps. Has racial Luck and Looting (the higher of this and the enchantment counts). In return, much less health.
race.rpgclasses.goblin.name: Goblin
race.rpgclasses.human.desc: Versatile: eases the drawbacks of their class. After choosing a class they pick a wall, whose penalty is reduced according to Rank; the class's negative base traits are reduced the same way. No environmental perks.
race.rpgclasses.human.name: Human
race.rpgclasses.infernal.desc: Immune to fire and lava, but cold and water hurt more and entering water slowly burns them. With Iron's Spells they have racial fire spells always available, which suffer your class's Magic wall like any spell. Iron golems always attack them and villagers charge them more.
race.rpgclasses.infernal.name: Infernal
race.rpgclasses.orc.desc: Bigger and tougher. Once per life they survive a lethal hit with half a heart. In return they use more hunger and are easier to hit.
race.rpgclasses.orc.name: Orc
race.rpgclasses.triton.desc: Breathes underwater, swims faster, mines underwater at normal speed and sees in the dark underwater. Fire hurts more and in the Nether they have Weakness.
race.rpgclasses.triton.name: Triton
race.rpgclasses.undead.desc: Breathes underwater, their hunger is fixed and they constantly regenerate health (interrupted for a few seconds when taking damage). Direct sunlight damages them even with a helmet, and neither healing potions nor spells heal them.
race.rpgclasses.undead.name: Undead
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.deep.2.desc: Offer 64 ores of at least 3 types.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.deep.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar underground.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.1.desc: Defeat 20 enemies with your own explosions.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.2.desc: Craft and offer 16 TNT (crafted while doing this rite).
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss that takes at least 4 of your explosions.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies with a weapon you crafted.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.2.desc: Offer an iron armor set and an iron weapon crafted by you.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.2.o0: Iron armor and weapon made by you
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss while wearing all 4 diamond (or netherite) armor pieces crafted by you.
rite.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.3.o0: Boss defeated in your diamond armor
rite.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies with a weapon you enchanted at the table.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.1.o0: Enemies defeated with your enchanted weapon
rite.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.2.desc: Enchant 3 items at the table and offer them.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.3.desc: Offer 2 books with the same enchantment at its maximum level.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.dark.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies in light level 7 or less.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.dark.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss at night, using Smoke Cloud at least 3 times during the fight.
rite.rpgclasses.elf.dark.3.o0: Boss defeated at night with 3 Clouds
rite.rpgclasses.elf.sylvan.2.desc: Offer 16 each of 4 different crops (64 in total).
rite.rpgclasses.elf.sylvan.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar in a forest biome.
rite.rpgclasses.fail.ability: too few uses of the ability
rite.rpgclasses.fail.boss_hits: too few hits taken from the boss
rite.rpgclasses.fail.crafted_diamond: you were not wearing your diamond armor
rite.rpgclasses.fail.mounted: you dismounted the wolf or it died
rite.rpgclasses.fail.racial_share: too little damage with racial spells
rite.rpgclasses.fail.wall_share: too little damage with your wall's discipline
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.thief.2.desc: Offer 64 mob loot items of at least 8 types.
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.thief.3.desc: Offer 3 pieces of mob gear (stolen or dropped by mobs you killed) and defeat a rite boss.
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.trapper.1.desc: Defeat 20 enemies caught by your Snare.
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.trapper.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss immobilized by your Snare at least 3 times.
rite.rpgclasses.goblin.wolf_rider.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss mounted on your wolf for the whole fight without it dying.
rite.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.1.desc: Defeat 6 enemies of each of 5 different mob types.
rite.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.2.desc: Surround the altar with 15 bookshelves (like an enchanting table: 2 blocks away, at its height or one higher) and offer 10 books.
rite.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.3.desc: Offer a book enchanted with an enchantment at its maximum level, a level II potion and a map explored almost completely (90%).
rite.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.1.desc: Defeat 10 enemies with each of 3 different combat styles (magic, bow, heavy weapons, light weapons or unarmed).
rite.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.2.desc: Offer on the altar one item of each category: heavy weapon, light weapon, bow or crossbow, shield, armor piece and a spell scroll or book.
rite.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.3.desc: Summon a rite boss at the altar and defeat it using the disciplines of your two chosen walls, with at least 25% of the damage in each (Armor: wear 3+ pieces; Shields: block 10 hits).
rite.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.3.o0: Boss defeated with your two walls
rite.rpgclasses.human.specialist.1.desc: Defeat 40 enemies with the discipline of your chosen wall.
rite.rpgclasses.human.specialist.2.desc: Offer on the altar a high-quality item (diamond or better, or enchanted if it has no tier) of your wall's discipline.
rite.rpgclasses.human.specialist.3.desc: Summon a rite boss and defeat it dealing at least 90% of the damage with your wall's discipline.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.native.1.desc: Defeat 30 hostile Nether mobs (piglins and hoglins don't count).
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.native.2.desc: Barter 20 times with piglins and offer 16 Nether quartz.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.native.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar in the Nether.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.pyromaniac.1.de: Defeat 40 enemies with your racial spells.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.pyromaniac.2.de: Offer 8 fire charges, 4 magma blocks and 8 blaze rods.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.pyromaniac.3.de: Defeat a rite boss dealing at least 50% of the damage with racial spells.
